_comment: The EARLY check (GATE-SPEED-2320): the gate's early stage as its own fast command. early_check.py reads this list; branch_early.sh (runner, ~5-8 min) runs every part, early_local.ps1 / early_local.sh (workstation, ~3-5 min) runs all but the layout part. unit_specs = node-only frontend/tests/unit-*.spec.ts that assert a rule over the WHOLE repository source ('every screen with a header keeps the lead reserve', 'no raw colour outside the tokens', ...) or over a registry every screen must be in; `early_check.py discover` lists unit specs that read the source tree but are not here (candidates to review, not added automatically). Specs that need a build (dist assets) or a browser page are not eligible. backend_tests = pytest files under smplwise_vms/backend/tests that are repository lints. layout = the gate's early layout list (gate_early_layout.json), runner only.
